Commercial property isn’t just about the building.

It’s about the businesses inside it, the customers they serve and whether those customers will still be there in five or ten years.

That’s why I’m always looking beyond the property itself.

In this week’s Commercial Insider, I look at where retail is actually working, why some office markets are tighter than the headlines suggest, what unsold auction properties can tell us and why understanding a vendor’s motivation can change the deal.

The biggest lesson?

Don’t invest in the headline. Invest in the detail.
